title: Experience the Wines of the Montérégie in a Private Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended to bring children as this is a wine tasting tour
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Escape the city and discover the hidden gem of the Richelieu Valley, located less than an hour from Montréal. This picturesque wine region is home to a growing collection of award-winning wineries, producing exceptional wines that are still one of Québec's best-kept secrets. Surrounded by beautiful vineyards and charming countryside, you'll enjoy an authentic wine country experience away from the crowds.

Travel alone or with a maximum of five additional people, allowing for a more personalized and relaxed atmosphere throughout the day. Meet passionate winemakers, hear the stories behind their craft, and gain exclusive insight into the art of local winemaking. With guided tastings, warm hospitality, and breathtaking scenery, this immersive experience offers the perfect opportunity to savor the flavors of Montérégie while creating lasting memories.
